citation_policy: arXiv id/title/authors/year verified from Hugging Face Hub papers metadata. Venue and DOI UNVERIFIED unless later confirmed. No fabricated citations. Hub AI summaries are not used as scientific claims.

papers.title: Ignore Previous Prompt: Attack Techniques For Language Models
papers.problem: Direct prompt injection (goal hijacking, prompt leaking) against instruction-following LLMs.
papers.method: PromptInject adversarial prompt composition; case study on GPT-3.
papers.primary_metric: Attack success on hijack/leak tasks (text-level).
papers.relevance: Establishes the prompt-injection threat this project assumes.
papers.limitation_vs_rq: No tool-using agents; no detector–policy isolation; no Tool-HASR.

papers.title: Not what you've signed up for: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.problem: Indirect prompt injection via retrieved/untrusted data in LLM-integrated apps.
papers.method: Taxonomy and real-world case studies of IPI.
papers.benchmark: Real-world application case studies (not a locked agent pack).
papers.primary_metric: Qualitative/case ASR; not Tool-HASR.
papers.relevance: Defines IPI, a core threat class for P2/Q2 agent trajectories.

papers.title: Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses in LLM-Integrated Applications

papers.relevance: Closest early systematic attack/defense taxonomy for injection.
papers.limitation_vs_rq: Application tasks, not locked agent intervention policy; not Tool-HASR; not cross-target Δ sign.

papers.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
papers.problem: Need a dynamic environment to evaluate agent attacks and defenses over untrusted tool data.
papers.method: AgentDojo dynamic eval framework; evolving attacks/defenses.
papers.evaluation_unit: Agent task completion under attack in a tool environment.

papers.limitation_vs_rq: Different pack, success definitions, and (from Hub metadata) no verified locked-policy detector-only Δ across independently selected targets. Cross-paper numeric comparison is a claims error.

papers.title: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents
papers.problem: Comprehensive attack/defense evaluation for LLM agents.
papers.method: ASB: 10 scenarios, 10 agents, 400+ tools, 23 attack/defense types, 8 metrics, ~90k cases.
papers.evaluation_unit: Agent operation stages (system prompt, user prompt, tool usage, memory).

papers.detector_policy_separately_controlled: PARTIAL — evaluates many defenses, but Hub metadata does not establish detector-only contrasts under a locked intervention policy.

papers.limitation_vs_rq: Different threat model/pack/metrics; cannot copy ASR into Q2 tables. Not verified as Q2-style isolation.

papers.title: IsolateGPT: An Execution Isolation Architecture for LLM-Based Agentic Systems
papers.problem: Insufficient isolation among LLM apps/tools and the system.

papers.title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design

detector_only_effects.note: Detection-only papers exist. Q2 is not novel merely for having detectors.

policy_only_effects.note: Runtime rails and architectural isolation exist. Q2 does not invent intervention policy.

examples: AgentDojo/ASB defense tables (unverified whether policy is locked)
detector_policy_decomposition.note: Prior work isolates *design channels* or evaluates stacked defenses. Surveyed Hub metadata does not show a factorial that holds agent intervention policy fixed and varies detector identity to estimate Tool-HASR Δ.

fixed_policy_detector_comparison.note: Possible overlap if those harnesses swap detectors under a shared policy. Not verified from Hub metadata alone. Do not claim 'first'.

tool_harm_execution_primary_endpoint.note: Action/tool success is used. Q2's Tool-HASR is a pre-registered success_condition on mock tools plus dual Judge-ASR/M3/M4 — related, not unique as an idea.

target_model_sensitivity_of_detector_eff.note: Multi-model evals exist. Whether they estimate detector-related Δ vs a no-detection arm under locked intervention is UNVERIFIED.

cross_model_consistency_under_locked_int.note: No surveyed paper was verified to pre-register Δ sign agreement of detector-vs-D0 Tool-HASR across independently selected secondary targets under one locked intervention policy. Exhaustive literature proof is not claimed.

survey_limitations: Venue/DOI not in Hub metadata — marked UNVERIFIED.

Not an exhaustive literature review; additional papers exist (e.g. DataFilter 2510.19207, SafeAgent 2604.17562, AgentWall 2605.16265, WAInjectBench 2510.01354) and were noted in search but not fully extracted.
Cannot claim 'first' or CLEAR GAP solely from this survey.
Do not copy numeric results from other papers into Q2 tables.
